name: Source Library
description: Source Library provides direct access to ~15,000 books translated to English from Latin, Sanskrit, Chinese, German, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Tibetan, and more. Plus search embedding space and get linked directly to the page of the original scanned book. Stable citation URLs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Source Library to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Source Library to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sourcelibrary.org/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Source Library MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Source Library provides these MCP tools: search_library, search_translations, search_concept, search_within_book, list_books, get_book, get_book_text, get_quote, search_images, and submit_feedback.

_published_faq.name: Does Source Library MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Source Library requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Source Library is developed by Source Library. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
